title: Nourishing Lamination-Puff Ukrainian Morbier Tagine
description: Spicy, shaggy, indulgent Ukrainian dish featuring morbier, lamination-puff, and macrobiotic-friendly ingredients, cooked in a traditional tagine pot.

ingredients.name: morbier cheese
ingredients.notes: softer portion of morbier cheese separated for melting purposes

ingredients.name: kasha
ingredients.type: boiled buckwheat groats with nutty flavor

ingredients.name: red onion
ingredients.type: thinly sliced red onion rings for garnish

ingredients.name: carrots
ingredients.notes: peeled and sliced in 1.5cm thick pieces

ingredients.name: canned tomatoes
ingredients.type: diced tomatoes with garlic and onion flavors

ingredients.name: spices
ingredients.notes: mix of paprika, cumin, and coriander for bold flavor
ingredients.type: dry spice blend for tagine stew

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.type: for pastry brushing and simmering stew

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.type: freshly squeezed for acidity and brightness

instructions: Preheat the tagine pot or a large Dutch oven to 180e1C (350e1F) with 20g of olive oil for 10 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots and celery to the preheated tagine pot and saut60 for 5 minutes until slightly caramelized.
Add the minced garlic, boiled kasha, diced canned tomatoes, and spice mix to the pot and stir for 2 minutes.
Separate the softer portion of morbier cheese and add it to the pot, stirring for another 2 minutes.
Place one square puff pastry piece on top of the stew and fold the edges over to form a shaggy crust, brush with olive oil, and pierce with a fork to allow steam to escape.
Repeat the pastry layering process 2 more times, allowing each layer to rest and puff before adding the next.
Brush the top layer of pastry with water, then brush with olive oil and score the pastry with a sharp knife to allow steam to escape.
Place the tagine pot in the preheated oven and bake for 30 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown and puffed.
Garnish with thinly sliced red onion rings and serve hot with lemon wedges.
